Topic.label: Combined Problems on Inverse Proportion Functions and Linear Functions

Question: The graphs of the linear function \(y=x+1\) and the inverse proportion function \(y=6/x\) intersect at points with x-coordinates 2 and -3. What is the solution set of the inequality \(x+1>6/x\)?
Solution: The range of x for which the graph of the linear function lies above the graph of the inverse proportion function is \(-3<x<0\) or \(x>2\). Check: when \(x=-1\), \(0>-6\) is true; when \(x=1\), \(2>6\) is false; when \(x=3\), \(4>2\) is true. Note that \(x\ne0\).

Original.prompt: 一次函数 y=x+1 与反比例函数 y=6/x 的图象交点的横坐标为 2 和 -3。则不等式 x+1>6/x 的解集是？
Original.explanation: 一次函数图象在反比例函数图象上方的 x 范围：-3<x<0 或 x>2。验证：x=-1 时 0>-6 成立；x=1 时 2>6 不成立；x=3 时 4>2 成立。注意 x≠0。
